labels: RAW venue rows, preserved verbatim. Nothing here is a position, a P&L or a settlement; it is what the account record says about orders and their fill state.

verdict.why: a contract qualifies only when rows on BOTH outcomes carry a fill. Accepted-but-unfilled opposite-side orders do NOT qualify, which is exactly the distinction the question turns on.
